body.statement: Suppose both normalized PPML fits exist uniquely, the panel contains one observation per unit and period, the Moreau--Kastler fit uses equal observation weights with no covariates or offsets, and \(n_g/N=p_g\) for every \(g\in C\). Profiling its individual fixed effects gives the cohort-mean PPML time-score equations and \(\sum_{i=1}^{n_g}\widehat\mu^{\mathrm{MK}}_{git}=n_g\widehat\mu_{gt}\); consequently \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{MK}}^{\mathrm{ind}}=\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{CM}}\).
body.justification: The boundary result states the exact aggregation conditions under which the distinct individual and cohort-mean procedures coincide.
body.gap: Moreau--Kastler (2025, Appendix B2) links individual imputation to a fully interacted individual-level estimator; it does not state this profiling identity with the cohort-mean rank-one score used here.
body.consumer: Applied users can determine whether the cycle frontier transfers exactly to their implementation or only describes a cohort-mean benchmark.
